<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/cases/{caseId}/evals/holdout"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Holds out a grouped sample of the labelled records, classifies it once per variant with the held-out records left out of the evidence, and scores each variant against the historical labels. The first variant is compared with the others. The result is evidence for a reviewer, not a gate.

<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>

  parameters={[{"name":"caseId","in":"path","required":true,"schema":{"type":"integer","format":"int64"}}]}
>
